name: Sophie Hopkins
headline: Head of Delivery at Drive Digital

experiences.companyName: Noughts & Ones | B Corp Shopify Agency
experiences.description:
• Oversee the successful delivery of all client work including projects, retainers, discovery engagements and PAYG tasks across the agency.
• Lead and manage the delivery team, across design, development, SEO & accessibility, fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture.
• Own and continuously refine delivery frameworks, tools and processes to ensure efficiency, scalability, and high-quality outcomes.
• Act as the escalation point for delivery risks, client issues, and cross-functional challenges.
• Collaborate closely with commercial and strategy teams to ensure alignment between delivery capability and agency growth goals.
• Manage agency revenue tracking and recovery rates to ensure maximum profitability across the agency.
• Represent delivery in senior leadership discussions, contribute to strategic decision-making and agency wide planning.

experiences.companyName: Noughts & Ones | B Corp Shopify Agency
experiences.description:
• Leading and managing innovative web projects from initiation to completion.
• Coordinating and managing with cross-functional teams to develop and execute comprehensive delivery plans.
• Responsible for budgets and agency resource scheduling to ensure all projects stay on target.
• Managing relations with third parties and tech partners to ensure the successful implementation of recommendations and integrations.
• Main client contact throughout the entire delivery of the web project.
Creating and enforcing company processes to ensure the project is delivered to the highest standard.
Effectively communicating key project dependencies, risks and project updates to senior stakeholders.

• Manage new Shopify web builds and redesigns from discovery to launch.
• Implementation of Customer Optimisation Value strategy across client accounts.
• Head up Klaviyo/CLV strategy across client accounts from automated flow and campaign strategy to design, copywriting and A/B testing.
• Client account management across a diverse range of e-commerce brands (fashion, beauty, lifestyle, fitness and well-being).
• Implementation of a wide range of Shopify apps dependent on client needs - subscriptions, customer support, upsells and cross-sells, B2B functionality etc.
• KPI reporting across all platforms (Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Analytics etc.).
• Building out company processes across a range of applicable softwares.

• Managed and created content across the 3 company social media platforms.
• Managed and designed email marketing campaigns & flows through Klaviyo.
• Aided in the management of the Shopify store, optimising web pages and monitoring new website build.
• Created brochures, graphics and imagery for marketing purposes.
• Handled PR clients and contacts.

• Aided in creating and managing the shop website using the platform Shopify.
• Received e-commerce training from United Hardware Ireland and attended a workshops that focused on marketing & online site management.
• Managed and updated spreadsheets, reports and relevant company documents.
• Purchasing of office supplies and handling of staff expenses.

• Involved in planning and overseeing excursions, trips and group activities and communicating progress with teachers and host families.
• Co-ordinated with external transport and events staff to ensure all excursions ran smoothly.
• Attended staff meetings and liaised with the Centre Manager on student behaviour, well-being and progress.
• Prepared and updated spreadsheets, presentations, and other relevant documents.

• Member of the visual merchandising team who created and updated the shop floor design monthly to enhance the customer experience.
• Managed incoming stock orders, sorting, preparing and storing effectively for efficient stock management.
• Purchasing of store supplies and handling of employee expenses.
• Aided in the hiring and training process of new staff members.
• Greeted customers and offered assistance with selecting merchandise and listened to needs and desires to help aid in their shopping experience.
